## ClusterCoordinatorService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Platform.Coordination.ClusterCoordinatorService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Platform/Coordination/ClusterCoordinatorService.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Platform/Coordination/ClusterCoordinatorService.cs#L17).

Background service that maintains a single cluster coordinator via shared-storage lease competition. Acquires the leader/cluster-coordinator lease on startup and renews it while running. When the lease cannot be acquired or renewed, leadership is relinquished and the instance transitions to follower mode.
